rationale: Both translations and the English sense are correct, but the relation “different-common-word” is too categorical. Indonesian detik and Malaysian saat are standard terms for a second, while detik also occurs in Malaysian Malay and saat can refer more broadly to a moment. Teach this as a common national preference, not an exclusive contrast; there is no false-friend contrast.
